question: How is the enzyme adenylyl cyclase activated ?:

options.opa: By interacting directly with membrane receptors activated by its ligand.
options.opb: By interacting directly with Gsα subunits that have previously bound GTP.
options.opc: By interacting directly with Gsα subunits that have previously bound GDP.
options.opd: By interacting directly with the cyclic AMP (cAMP) produced by the Gsα subunits.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: By interacting directly with Gsα subunits that have previously bound GTP -> Activation of adenylyl cyclase -> 90% CHAIN: By interacting directly with Gsα subunits that have previously bound GTP -> Gsα subunits stimulate adenylyl cyclase to produce cAMP -> 85% CHAIN: By interacting directly with Gsα subunits that have previously bound GTP -> Gsα subunits bind to adenylyl cyclase, leading to its activation -> 90%
